Method of Attack: Exploitation of a fundamental design flaw in the RADIUS protocol to stage Mallory-in-the-middle (MitM) attacks, bypass integrity checks, and conduct forgery attacks
Impacted Systems: All standards-compliant RADIUS clients and servers
Organizations using RADIUS for administrator logins
Networks using PAP, CHAP, and MS-CHAPv2 authentication methods
Attack Vector: Modification of RADIUS packets in transit
Exploitation of cryptographically insecure MD5-based integrity checks
Chosen prefix attack on Access-Request packets
